checks.name: author-signed receipt
checks.observation: validate_receipt rejects reviewer equal to the dataset author.

checks.name: forged file hash
checks.observation: prepare rejects a receipt whose train_sha256 is not the train file.

checks.name: self-declared legal verification
checks.observation: A receipt with legal_license_authentication VERIFIED is rejected.

checks.name: unreviewed dataset execution
checks.observation: train_lora --execute on UNREVIEWED data exits 2 and does not create an output directory.

checks.name: token rearrangement
checks.observation: The same token set with a different answer is rejected as contradictory targets.

checks.name: cross-tenant
checks.observation: A tenant mismatch exits 2 before weights are loaded.

checks.name: independent legal review of a real corpus
checks.observation: No customer or third-party corpus was submitted. Screening does not prove a license or the absence of contamination.
